title: Development of a patient database for patients with hemodialysis dependency and indication for shunt placement in Benin, West Africa
summary:
- Collection of epidemiological data on patients with end-stage renal disease at the CNHU-HKM
- Establishment of a digital patient database at the CNHU-HKM for prospective data collection and long-term data retention
- Comparison of epidemiological, procedure-related and follow-up data for hemodialysis shunts between the UKA and the CNHU-HKM (prospective data collection/matched pairs analysis).
- Determination of quality of life in patients with terminal renal insufficiency at both hospitals using a standardized questionnaire (EQ-5D-5L, EQ-VAS score)
- Determination of the duration and frequency of hemodialysis and comparison between patients at UKA and CNHU-HKM (matched pairs analysis).
- Determination of the frequency of surgical revisions after AV shunt placement in both countries.

interventions.name: Not applicable, as no intervention takes place (apart from a blood sample as part of the routine and collection of a questionnaire). Only a database is set up.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with chronic, terminal renal insufficiency and an existing indication for mandatory hemodialysis
Exclusion criteria:
Post renal transplant
Peritoneal dialysis
Passenger, acute renal insufficiency
Daily body temperature (measured in ear) >38°C
Septic phlebitis
Severe cognitive impairment
Temporary need for dialysis
Lack of artery or vein required for the application
